speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: Good evening, have you heard of Save the Children charity?

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: No, tell me about it!

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: It is a non-government organization that supports children and gives help.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: Where is the organization based?

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: It is based out of London but is a world-wide organization.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: What kind of support does it provide to children?  Food? Medical? Education?

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: It is dedicated to helping children in distress, such as during a hurricane disaster. It also helps the children in underprivileged countries.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: How does the aid reach the children?

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: Through donations in all parts of the states. They have fundraisers during the year to make money for the children.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: No, I mean how effective ifs the organization at getting the aid to the children.  So many times money to charity is wasted on ineffective policies, politics and poor routes of delivery.

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: Over 88% of the money goes to the children. This organization is very efficient and only 5% goes to the administrators.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: That  is good.

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: Yes, they are a very worthy organization.  Their vision is a world in which every child attains the right to survival, protection, development and participation.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: Sounds like a good cause.

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: Yes, a very worthy cause. Do you think this is something you would be interested in helping the children get a good start in life?

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: Yes, I think I could help out with that!

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: That is great and the donation is tax deductible. How much would you like to donate to this great organization?

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: Let me think about it for a minute...

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: Sure, no problem.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: I would be happy to donate $1.00

speaker: ARFQ8FJRKCUZ6
text: Thanks. You are making a difference in a child's life, one which will be greatly appreciated.

speaker: AON59V5VZU2AK
text: You are welcome!
